# Insights: what each figure means

> One definition per figure, for the people who build the panels and the people who read them. Where two panels say
> the same word, they count the same thing; where they cannot, the word differs. From the audit's T1.9
> (`docs/insights-audit-2026-11-07.md`). Code pointers are the one place each rule lives.

| Figure | Means | Where it lives |
|---|---|---|
| **Visit** | A student at a session that has taken place: a booking that ended, unless the student was marked absent where a host took attendance; a walk-in a host marked in. A booking ahead is a plan, not a visit. | `services/audienceVisits.ts` (`loadVisitBookings`) |
| **Returning students / repeat rate** | Of the students who visited in the window, the share with two visits or more. Reported only from five distinct students. The same rule on the overview tile, the Classes table (per class) and the Audience page. | `instructorMetrics.ts`, `instructorAudience.ts` |
| **Attendance rate** (overview tile) | Among the students a host marked, the share marked present: attended over attended plus no-show. Sessions nobody marked are not in it. | `instructorMetrics.ts` §3 |
| **Attendance** (Trends band, weekday chart, the highlights) | People who came per session, over the sessions whose attendance is **known**: a host marked someone there, or the class books natively (we hold the ledger). A class that books elsewhere is unknown until someone marks it, and is left out, never read as zero. | `services/analytics/sessionAttendance.ts` |
| **Fill** | Enrolment over capacity, clamped to 100 %. Enrolment is our bookings for a native class, the provider's seat count for an imported one, and **unknown** for a class that books elsewhere with no figure. Unknown is skipped, never 0. An appointment class (hourly slots) has no fill. | `class/sessionEnrolment.ts`, `metricPrimitives.ts` |
| **Bookings** | Held bookings: confirmed, or completed once the session ended. Cancelled and expired are not bookings. | `metricPrimitives.ts` (`ACTIVE_BOOKING_STATUSES`) |
| **Earnings / revenue** | Money captured through Student Body on fixed-price classes, net of refunds, including a late cancellation's retained money. The headline and charts are in the home currency; the per-currency list counts every currency. Packs and memberships are in the Reports, not here. `null` where the window has no fixed-price class, `0` where it has one and no money. | `metricPrimitives.ts` (`bookingRevenueCents`) |
| **First-time share** | Of a class's own pre-class check-ins, the share answering "first time". Absent until the class has four of its own; never another class's. | `demandEngine/buildClassIdentityProfile.ts` |
| **Reach** | Views (PostHog, consent-gated, so an undercount; `—` when unavailable), link opens and contact taps on a class that books elsewhere, "yes I booked" answers, and the booked-elsewhere records those made (the student's word, never a Booking; no ledger row is counted). | `services/analytics/operatorEngagement.ts` |
| **Demand window** | A day × time of day with a demand score: from the fill of the sessions held there, or from students' stated preferences where the teacher holds none (the open window: "students on Student Body said they are free then", #3810). | `demandEngine/buildDemandWindows.ts` |
| **Opportunity** | A suggestion scored from signals, each signal with a weight. A class-level one (add a session, duplicate a class) wears only the teacher's own best-filling time of day; "test a new slot" wears the window students ask for. Its forecast rests on its own signals. | `opportunitySignalRegistry.ts`, `demandEngine/getOpportunities.ts` |
| **Outcome** (parked panel) | A suggestion acted on, measured 14 days later against the teacher's last 30 days as they were when the card was shown, over the same length. An exposure from before baselines were stored is **unmeasured**, not a win. | `demandEngine/evaluateSuggestionOutcomes.ts` |
| **How they found us** (Reach) | The signup question's answers from the students who signed up after seeing this teacher, as counts per answer. Withheld below three answers, so one signup cannot expose one student's; one or two answers say the list is coming. | `services/attribution/getInstructorAttributionStats.ts` |
| **What students say they came for** (Feedback page) | After a class: the review tags students ticked, every kind including the teacher-only ones, by count. In Discover: the Like and Hide marks on the teacher and on each class. A count under the privacy floor (three) is held back, never shown as 0, and a Hide is never broken down per class. | `services/reviews/getEntitySignals.ts`, `services/analytics/instructorTasteSignals.ts` |
| **A class's identity** (under a Classes row) | What its own students said: the traits the engine reads (first-timer friendly, high return, atmosphere-driven, intense, beginner-friendly), its first-time share, how its check-ins found the level, its feedback tags by count. A class with nothing from its students says so. | `demandEngine/buildClassIdentityProfile.ts` |
| **Seat snapshot** (no panel yet) | A reading of a session's seats taken and its room, kept each hour only when it moved: our held bookings for a native class, the provider's count for an imported or linked one; nothing for an appointment slot or an unknown enrolment. The fill curve "days to sell out" and "late drops" will read. | `services/analytics/seatSnapshots.ts` |
| **Want to join** (home strip, narrative, portfolio chip, `demand_overflow`) | Demand the teacher could not take, from what we hold: students waiting or offered on an upcoming session's waitlist; students with a standing "tell me if a spot opens" ask on an upcoming session that books elsewhere; plus link or contact opens in the last 30 days on a session whose last seat reading before the open said full. No reading yet is unknown, not full; one student counts once per session (an ask counts them, their open then does not); a guest's open once. Peer invites are never in it. | `demandEngine/getDemandCounts.ts`, `booking/spotAlerts.ts` |
| **Class language** (`language_demand`, "Offer classes in …", signal explorer) | The students in the operator's class-type pool who kept **only** one class language on the availability step or in Practice preferences, in a language none of the operator's classes are in: "said they prefer classes in English". A student who kept two languages said either suits them and counts for neither. Only what a student kept counts; the suggestion from their app language that pre-selects the chips is never counted (it ranks their own recommendations only). Five or more, the type pool's floor. The same count for every operator teaching the type. Silent while any of the operator's classes has no language recorded (unknown is not none). A teacher of several types sees the languages of the type pool where most students kept a language, which may differ from the pool their times come from; each reading is one type's count with its own total. | `services/instructorPreferences.ts` (`onlyLanguages`), `demandEngine/getDemandSignals.ts` |
| **Interest** (demand window, cell detail, "Looked at" in the briefing) | What students showed beyond fill: the saves of the classes held in the window (each class once, all time) plus the opens that met a full session there (want to join's turned-away rule). Page views are not in it. "Looked at, didn't fill" is five or more of these against a known fill under half over two sessions or more; it is read before "cooling", so low fill with interest behind it is a conversion gap, not weak demand. | `demandEngine/buildDemandWindows.ts`, `analyzeSchedulePatterns.ts` |

## Windows

| Surface | Window |
|---|---|
| Teacher's Insights tabs with the picker | the picked 30 days, 3 months or 6 months |
| Teacher's Schedule tab, Opportunities, Suggested actions | the engine's last 30 days |
| Home strip and narrative deltas | the last two complete weeks, trends over 8 weeks |
| Portfolio tiers | all-time performance, 30-day context |
| Studio Insights | twelve weeks by default, twelve months at the picker; the Highlights compare it with the same length before |
| Audience page | all time |

## Words to avoid

- "Attendance" for a provider-enrolled or off-platform class: we know the seats, not who came.
- "Returning" from held bookings: a no-show did not return.
- "0 %" where the figure is unknown: say nothing, or say unknown.
- "Can't take a class in …" for a class language: a preference is not an inability. Say "prefer".
